correctness.rationale: Choose countably many distinct variables and, for each binary sequence, form the allowed countable conjunction of its selected literals. Each conjunction is nonzero under the matching two-valued assignment, while any two distinct conjunctions have zero meet at their first differing coordinate. This yields a continuum-sized disjoint nonzero family, so c.c.c. fails. The paper defines almost measurability by c.c.c. plus weak countable distributivity and defines both later model classes using an almost-measurable algebra, making their nonexistence a direct definitional consequence.

value.rationale: The finding is a decisive structural boundary for a newly introduced semantics: its defining c.c.c. requirement is incompatible with the language strength used to build the Lindenbaum--Tarski algebra. This makes the advertised model class empty as stated and pinpoints the exact ingredients any repair must change. The claim is therefore more than a routine Boolean-algebra exercise.
